summary.en: Pen name shared by three Spanish screenwriters, Jorge Díaz, Agustín Martínez and Antonio Mercero. Presented at first as a reclusive woman novelist, the trio stepped forward in October 2021, when La Bestia won the Premio Planeta.

en: First novel under the name: La novia gitana (The Gypsy Bride), 2018
La Bestia won the 2021 Premio Planeta, worth €1 million
